description: paper_configs_v3: GPT-2 large spline vs linear feature-match at d_t=10240 (R=8, 2x v2). KAN encoders are FSDP-ignored (fp32, fully replicated): ~70 GiB/GPU encoder. Run on 6 nodes x 2 GPUs (world=12): 1B x 0.95 / (384 x 128) = 19330 steps (~1.5x faster wall-clock than 4 nodes). Peak ~105 GiB/rank on 146GB. 1B tokens, 2 seeds. Grid refine DISABLED, deduped val. Reuses paper_v2 activation cache. Results under results/paper/paper_v3_gpt2_large/.
